{{Quote|My name's Dranok. Anything that's worth having in this galaxy, you can get through us.|Dranok regarding himself and Skarl|<ref name="Red Harvest (novel)">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref>}}
'''Dranok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He usually partnered with the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] [[Skarl]]. They were two of the many bounty hunters who were hired to hunt down and find the [[Murakami orchid]] for [[Darth Scabrous]]. He tried to cheat him selling a false orchid but Scabrous uncovered the bluff, killing Skarl and serving his head to Dranok, promising he could leave if he ate his former partner's head. Dranok attempted to use the knife provided to attack Scabrous, but the Sith Force-choked him into submission and left him to his [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]].
